mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_fulfillment_ingress(tenant_id,actor_key,operation,source_request_id,request_hash,observed_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{actor},#{operation},#{source},#{hash},#{at}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=tc_fulfillment_ingress.id
mapper.select: SELECT id,request_hash,observed_at,result_no,result_status,result_version FROM tc_fulfillment_ingress WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND actor_key=#{actor} AND operation=#{operation} AND source_request_id=#{source} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_fulfillment_ingress SET result_no=#{number},result_status=#{status},result_version=#{version} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND result_no IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS order_id,o.order_no,i.stock_type,i.quantity FROM tc_order_item i JOIN tc_order o ON o.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND o.id=i.order_id JOIN tc_order_fulfillment f ON f.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND f.order_id=o.id WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND i.id=#{item}
SELECT order_no FROM tc_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}

SELECT r.return_no,o.order_no,CAST(r.order_item_id AS CHAR) AS order_item_id,CAST(r.warehouse_id AS CHAR) AS warehouse_id,r.quantity,r.status,r.receipt_no,r.version FROM tc_return_request r JOIN tc_order o ON o.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND o.id=r.order_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.business_no=#{number}r.return_no=#{number}

SELECT r.return_no,o.order_no,CAST(r.order_item_id AS CHAR) AS order_item_id,CAST(r.warehouse_id AS CHAR) AS warehouse_id,r.quantity,r.status,r.receipt_no,r.version FROM tc_return_request r JOIN tc_order o ON o.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND o.id=r.order_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.return_no=#{number} FOR UPDATE OF r
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_return_request SET status='INSPECTED',receipt_no=#{receipt},version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND return_no=#{number} AND version=#{version} AND status='OPEN'
